automation.description: Used by the recorder round-trip test: in an already signed-in SmartClient (desktop UX/UI) session, a user opens links in new windows, uses list grid tools, goes back and reloads, while the recorder writes a script of what was done, which is then replayed.

interaction.name: New windows, list grid tools, back and refresh
interaction.description: Opens a new lookup value in a new window, makes it, opens the List Grid Fixture in a nested window and checks the value is listed, closes both, refreshes, selects and deselects the row, opens a PDF in a new window, then checks Back and Reload throw away an unsaved edit and deletes the lookup value.

method.comment: A lookup value made in a new window, and the List Grid Fixture opened by its URL in a window nested in it

navigateLink.text: Open a new lookup value in a new window

method.comment: Back in the first window: the list grid shows the new value once refreshed; select it, then deselect it
A PDF in a new window, which records nothing: it is closed when the next step is in this window

navigateLink.text: Open a PDF in a new window
